thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 1769991234 - dedicated-resv-pool saturation detected for pool resv-eu-west-2-03. queue_length > 1200, GPUs at 100% across nodes. autoscaler reached max_replicas. severity: P1
Sam (oncall): paging in. I'm on it.
Eli: I'm awake, joining. What's impacted? any customer-facing 5xx/429s?
incident-bot: Metrics alert: 5xx_rate spike for dedicated routes -> 429 throttles observed for tenant GraniteBank (tenant_id: ten-44a2). Avg latency token generation 1.8s -> requests queuing.
Tanvi: Confirming - dashboard shows reservation 'resv-eu-west-2-03' utilization 100%, queued requests growing, autoscaler prevented further scale due to `max_replicas: 12` in pool config.
Leah: @Sam do we have burst capacity for this pool? can we failover GraniteBank to another reserved pool?
Sam (oncall): Not automatically. We've got two options: 1) emergency manual scale-up (request more GPUs from infra) 2) throttle/evict noisy tenant sessions to free slots 3) route some traffic to hosted fallback for GraniteBank to keep SLOs.
Eli: I'll check which tenants have long-running sessions. running query: `select tenant_id, count(active_sessions) from resv_sessions where pool='resv-eu-west-2-03' group by tenant_id order by count desc;`
Eli: results: GraniteBank 78 sessions, acme-data 9, analytics-hub 5, internal-testing 1. GraniteBank is obvious noisy neighbor.
Amy (cs): FYI CS reports multiple customer 429s and a support ticket from GraniteBank complaining about increased latency. They want SLA explanation.
Tanvi: We should apply a soft quota to GraniteBank first to avoid full evictions. Command to set tenant concurrency cap: `redwoodctl tenant set-quota --tenant ten-44a2 --pool resv-eu-west-2-03 --concurrency 12`
Sam (oncall): Applying now.
ops-bot: Executing: `redwoodctl tenant set-quota --tenant ten-44a2 --pool resv-eu-west-2-03 --concurrency 12`
ops-bot: Done. Returned: {"status":"ok","affected_sessions":0} (quota enforced on new requests).
Eli: Quota will stop new requests beyond 12 in-flight, but existing long-running sessions still hold GPUs. We need to target those long requests. Listing top sessions: `redwoodctl sessions list --pool resv-eu-west-2-03 --sort duration --limit 20`
Eli: Top sessions are mostly long re-ranking jobs from GraniteBank (duration 2h+, many batched runs).
Leah: Can we politely evict or migrate these batch jobs? customer might accept short window. @Amy can CS coordinate with GraniteBank to pause batch runs?
Amy (cs): Reached out to account manager, pinged contact. They're surprised, will confirm pause for 30m.
Tanvi: While we wait, I'll open emergency scale request to infra for +4 GPUs on this pool. tagging @infra-sig.
Tanvi: Request: `infra request-gpus --pool resv-eu-west-2-03 --count 4 --reason "P1 pool saturation GraniteBank"`
infra-sig: Acknowledged. Provisioning pipeline has cold-start time ~8-12m for new nodes. Queue position submitted.
Sam (oncall): In parallel: enable fallback routing for GraniteBank of lower-cost model variant to hosted for latency-sensitive endpoints. Command: `routes update --tenant ten-44a2 --route /generate --fallback hosted:gpt-medium --percent 50`
ops-bot: Executing route update.
ops-bot: Done. Routing 50% of /generate to hosted:gpt-medium.
Eli: Observing immediate reduction in queue growth rate — good. 429s still occurring for heavy batch endpoints though.
Leah: Infra reports +2 GPU nodes ready in ~9m, +2 more pending.
Sam (oncall): Once nodes are ready, autoscaler will add them but need to bump pool max_replicas to avoid hitting limit again. Set `max_replicas=18` temporarily.
Tanvi: Applying temporary pool config: `pools update resv-eu-west-2-03 --max-replicas 18 --ephemeral true`
ops-bot: Pool config updated. max_replicas now 18 (ephemeral flag set).
Eli: New nodes provisioning complete: +2 nodes joined, GPU utilization for pool drops to 86%, queue length decreasing from 1200 to 320.
Sam (oncall): Good. Keep quota in place for GraniteBank for now. Ask CS to request customer to stagger batch jobs and consider moving heavy batched re-ranking to off-peak or dedicated reserved capacity.
Amy (cs): Customer confirmed they'll pause the large jobs for 30m and accept staged reroutes. They requested ETA for full recovery. I'll tell them 20-30m and that we implemented throttles and fallback routing.
Leah: Post-mitigation checks: no 5xxs since nodes came up, 429 rate down to baseline. Recording: incident ramp started at 1769991234, manual mitigations applied at ~1769991500, extra nodes online by 1769992000.
Sam (oncall): I'm going to degrade severity to P2 in 30m if no regressions. We should create a follow-up to remove ephemeral max_replicas bump and evaluate autoscaler limits.
Tanvi: Action items: 1) revert max_replicas to original after stabilization 2) add tenant-level long-running job alerts 3) evaluate quota enforcement automation for noisy tenants 4) CS follow-up with GraniteBank for billing/commit discussion.
Eli: Also propose autoscaler rule tweak: if queue_length sustained > 500 and average_queue_wait > 3s for >5m, temporarily allow burst_replicas beyond max up to +25% with infra approval. I'll draft RFC.
Sam (oncall): Noted. I'll owner the postmortem. Creating incident ticket now.
ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-1769991234. severity=P1 (now P2 pending closure). assignees: Sam, Eli, Tanvi, Leah.
Sam (oncall): Thanks all. I'll keep monitoring for 1hr and then hand off to eng-sre for long-term follow-up.
Leah: Thx. Leaving a short log snippet for postmortem: ```
# logs excerpt
2026-03-15T02:07:12Z pool=resv-eu-west-2-03 queue=1242 replicas=12 max_replicas=12 autoscaler_event=limit_reached
2026-03-15T02:09:30Z tenant=ten-44a2 active_sessions=78 avg_latency=1.86s error_rate=3.4% 429_rate=2.1%
2026-03-15T02:18:40Z pool=resv-eu-west-2-03 replicas_added=2 nodes_ready=true
2026-03-15T02:27:01Z queue=318 replicas=14 utilization=86% 429_rate=0.1%
```
Sam (oncall): Closing ops channel here, moving postmortem notes to incidents/INC-2026-1769991234 doc. Ping me for any follow-ups. :thumbsup:
